title: Arc'teryx Beta Pant Men's - Solaris $150 (70% off) Delivered Only @ Arc'teryx Outlet
body:
Deal: Arc'teryx Beta Pant Men's - Solaris $150 (70% off) Delivered Only @ Arc'teryx Outlet

[shbshb] Look forward to seeing people in the CBD walking around in these.
[DevilsInDetails] Seen a lot at construction sites. You know, bright orange pants..
[kayndev] I tried the black one in store, zip on two sides, wouldn't recommend for casual.
[omguleh] It’s a waterproof outer shell, it’s not meant to be used like that.
[rumblytangara] Most glaringly ugly colour imaginable.
I ordered immediately. (Edit- seriously)
Limited zip pockets, which is a thing to consider.
These are supposed to go over your base layer or hiking/climbing pants hence the full length leg zips, they're not supposed to have pockets.
[DevilsInDetails] I’m a fashion guy. I wear Lululemon leggings inside.
[rumblytangara] Good thing Lululemon leggings have pockets then.
Unfortunately they cannot make up for how ugly these Arcteryx trousers are.
[shoppe] Good for strippers. Maybe tax deductible?
[shoppe] Not sure why I'm being neged?
I stand by my original comment. Fast removal for male strippers. Maybe tax deductible, although once removed maybe a spray tan could be deductible, too.
[shoppe] If these aren't good for male strippers, hence the full length zippers from top to bottom, on both the left and right sides, could someone explain what other use these two zipper could possibly be used for?
[omguleh] One of my favourites, I have the Alpha SV in orange :)
[liam2040] Ultimate battle of intended use case vs fashion victim
[michael9865] How on earth is this worth $500
I've seen similar go for $20
[rumblytangara] michael9865
I've seen similar go for $20
Good luck with that.
Three layer Goretex retails around $55 per metre and you will have a hard time even finding it as raw material in Australia. You'd need 2-3 metres of fabric to make these.
Even the full length zips (YKK, water resistant) retail for $20.
[alecator] Check the reviews if you're planning on getting these for hiking, price looks great for 3L Gore-Tex but there are some consistently raised points of poor function - namely that the snaps at the top don't stay fixed unless the zips are all the way up, pretty annoying with no external pockets or alternative vents
